column3: Did you see that?\nSomeone moved over there.{end_wait}
I saw it too.\nStay alert.{end_wait}
Could Dodonpa's men\nhave followed us?{end_now}
Then we'd better\nstop them here.\nHammet can't run.{end_wait}
If not the guards,\nthen who is it?{end_wait}
Wait! Don't move!{end_wait}
Bunza? Is that you?{end_wait}
That voice...\nIt can't be...{end_wait}
Hammet! You're alive!{end_wait}
Then Dodonpa never\nmeant to release you?{end_wait}
No. {actor_name:3} and his\nfriends\ncame to free me.{end_wait}
Once {actor_name:1} decided,\nwe went in together.\nWe weren't leaving him.{end_wait}
Hey, {actor_name:3}!\nDon't make it sound like\n{actor_name:1} did everything!{end_wait}
I didn't mean that!\n{actor_name:4} helped, and\nyou did too!{end_wait}
Thank you, {actor_name:1},\n{actor_name:2}, and {actor_name:4}.\nAll of you.{end_wait}
And you, {actor_name:3}.\nMost of all.{end_wait}
You found the cave,\nBunza. How?{end_wait}
Even the guards\ndidn't know we were here.\nWell done, Bunza.{end_wait}
It wasn't planned.\nI stumbled onto it.{end_wait}
I nearly turned back\nbefore I reached Lunpa.{end_wait}
We knew the thieves\nwere holding Hammet.\nI was afraid.{end_wait}
Then why come at all?{end_wait}
I remembered something\nHammet taught me\nabout trading.{end_wait}
To trade in Lunpa?\nAfter all this?{end_wait}
No. Something\nmore important than that.{end_wait}
Don't judge a customer\nby the way they look.{end_wait}
Don't turn back\njust because the road\nlooks dangerous.{end_wait}
If people are waiting\nfor what you carry,{page_break}you owe it to them\nto try to reach them.{end_wait}
So you came for\nthe people of Lunpa,\ndespite Dodonpa?{end_wait}
And found us instead.\nI suppose that's fate.{end_wait}
But you knew\nthe guards might refuse\na merchant from Kalay.{end_wait}
They did. I never\ngot past the gate.{end_wait}
And still you stayed?{end_wait}
Then there was a commotion\nat the fortress.\nI couldn't ignore it.{end_wait}
That must've been\nDonpa's diversion.{end_wait}
I thought it might\nhave something to do\nwith Hammet.{end_wait}
I had to be certain.\nSo I kept looking.{end_wait}
And you found this cave?{end_wait}
But that gate\nonly opens from inside.\nHow did you get through?{end_wait}
I didn't.\nThen it moved,\nand I hid behind a rock.{end_wait}
We gave you a fright,\ndidn't we?{end_wait}
I was more relieved\nthan afraid.\nHammet was with you.{end_wait}
You sound worried,\nBunza. What's wrong?{end_wait}
Dodonpa's men are\nsearching the roads.\nThey're everywhere.{end_wait}
They may not be\nlooking for Hammet.\nBut if they see him...{end_wait}
They'll take him back.\nWe have to leave now.{end_wait}
We need a way out\nthat won't draw attention.\nNot another fight.{end_wait}
What do you think,\n{actor_name:1}? Stay and fight?{end_now}
We barely made it\nout of that fortress.\nHammet needs rest.{end_wait}
Fighting an entire gang\nout here would be\na terrible risk.{end_wait}
Then what's our way out,\nBunza?{end_wait}
I brought a wagon.\nIt's just outside.{end_wait}
A wagon?{end_wait}
I can take everyone\nback to Kalay.\nCome with me.{end_wait}
The guards will search\nany wagon leaving Lunpa.\nWon't they?{end_wait}
They've seen mine\non the road for days.\nI look like any trader.{end_wait}
So your wagon\nwon't seem unusual.\nThat could work.{end_wait}
Exactly, {actor_name:2}.\nNo one suspects me.\nNot yet.{end_wait}
Then let's get Hammet\nhome to Kalay.{end_wait}
Should we ride\nwith them?{end_now}
You don't want\nto take the wagon?{end_now}
Changed your mind?\nAre we riding or not?{end_now}
You're changing it again?\nMake a decision!{end_wait}
We're wasting daylight.\nAre we going?{end_now}
Is there something\nyou still need\nto do in Lunpa?{end_now}
Then I'm staying\nwith you. No argument.{end_wait}
You two aren't staying\nalone. I'm not leaving you.{end_wait}
Hammet, I'll stay\nwith {actor_name:1}.\nThey still need me.{end_wait}
You should go with them,\n{actor_name:3}. They're your\nfriends.{page_break}I'll be safe now.{end_wait}
I wish we could travel\nhome together.{page_break}But I understand.\nBe careful, {actor_name:3}.{end_wait}
There they go...{end_wait}
I hope Bunza gets\nHammet safely to Kalay.{end_wait}
He knows the road.\nThey'll make it.{end_wait}
Then we have work to do.\nCome on, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Anything else you need\nto do before we leave?{end_now}
If you're finished here,\nwe should get going.\nKalay is waiting.{end_wait}
Layana will be relieved\nto see you again.{end_wait}
I want to see her.\nI've kept her waiting\nlong enough.{end_wait}
Then we're off to Kalay.{end_wait}
Still something to do\nhere in Lunpa?{end_now}
Don't tell me you've\nchanged your mind again.\nWe're ready to go!{end_now}
So you won't\nride in the wagon?{end_wait}
I'm sorry, {actor_name:1}.\nHammet can't stay\non these roads.{end_wait}
Will you stay here\nand finish your business?{end_now}
Thank you for teaching\nmy son a lesson.\nI know what he did.{end_wait}
Please accept this.\nI know it can't repay\nthe harm he's caused.{end_wait}
See that they receive\nthis gift from me.{end_wait}
Deep in these caves\nlives a strange creature.{page_break}I fought it years ago.\nIt may be useful to you.{end_wait}
It's yours now.\nTake care of it.{end_wait}
Donpa's grateful.\nHe won't forget\nwhat you did for us.{end_wait}
I want to believe\nDodonpa has changed.\nI don't know if he has.{end_wait}

Donpa's own son
brought this on him.{page_break}I wouldn't wish
such a decision
on any father.{end_wait}

I know he's done wrong.
But he's still my son.{page_break}Part of me wants
to open that cell
and bring him home.{end_wait}

The merchant from Kalay
is still somewhere
down here.{page_break}No one's coming
to rescue him.{end_wait}
Dodonpa's in this cell.\nOnly a few guards know.{page_break}We'd better keep\nour mouths shut.{end_wait}
I was wrong, Dad!\nI'll never do it again!\nJust let me out!{end_wait}

They put me here...
They'll regret this.{page_break}When I get out,
I'll make them pay.
Every last one.{end_wait}
I've spent years\ntraveling the world\nand helping others.{end_wait}
Gondowan is barren.\nCliffs, sand, and stone.\nStill, people live there.{end_wait}
Thieves' Stew.\nThe smell is hard\nto mistake.{end_wait}
Thieves' Cookies.\nWhy are they shaped\nlike Dodonpa's face?{end_wait}
Frogs are croaking\ndeep inside the well.{end_wait}
